description: This file implements the UserRepository class which provides data access methods for User entities in the database, using Entity Framework Core. It includes methods to get, add, update, delete, and list users, serving as an implementation of the IUserRepository interface.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A class that provides CRUD operations for User entities via Entity Framework Core, implementing the IUserRepository interface.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a User by its unique identifier asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByUsernameAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username asynchronously.

methods.name: GetByEmailAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a User by email asynchronously.

methods.name: ExistsByEmailAsync
methods.description: Checks if a User exists with the given email asynchronously.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new User to the database asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing User in the database asynchronously.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a User from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all Users as a list asynchronously.
